subject: Breakout Track + Integration Demo Pod — Sponsorship Opportunity
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@techforum.co>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Breakout track + integration demo pod — initial package

Hi Rishi (and Kimberly),

Thanks for taking a call last week — really excited about Redwood participating at TechForum West. Attached is our latest sponsor package (TechForum_SponsorPackage_v3.pdf) with the breakout-track + integrated demo pod option we discussed. High level:

- Breakout session (45 minutes) in the Privacy & Data Ops track — 1 speaker slot, 30 min talk + 15 min Q&A.
- Demo Pod in the exhibit hall: 3x3 branded pod, 6 hours/day staffing, shared power and one 4k monitor, priority placement near main walkway.
- Logo placement: Platinum logo on website (homepage rotation), session slide, on-site signage (stage-side banner), and program guide.
- Perks: 50 attendee leads (Opt-in), 10 complimentary VIP passes, 1 hosted roundtable (12 people).

Proposed fee for the combined package: $45,000. We can tweak deliverables if certain line items are must-haves for Redwood.

A couple of clarifications we need from you: 1) any exclusivity requests for the demo pod (competitor list), 2) AV/power requirements beyond the standard monitor/power, and 3) preferred speaker for the breakout session (title and bio).

If that looks reasonable, I'll send a SOW and DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks — Elena
--
Elena Rossi
Director, Strategic Partnerships
TechForum Events
attachments: TechForum_SponsorPackage_v3.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@techforum.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Breakout track + integration demo pod — initial package

Elena — thanks for the deck and the clear outline. A few quick asks so we can move toward terms: 

1) Demo pod power/AV: can you confirm dedicated circuit availability and whether we can request an additional monitor? Our demo requires a small appliance + laptop + a live inference demo running on an edge box — I'll attach our demo pod spec sheet (Redwood_DemoPod_Specs.xlsx).

2) Logo placement: homepage rotation is fine — can we get a mock of the stage-side banner? We want to confirm visibility from the main aisle.

3) Exclusivity: we don't need category exclusivity but would like a short non-compete clause for other inference/platform vendors on the same day/adjacent pod (list to be provided).

4) Speaker: would like to propose our Head of Product, Marissa Cole, to present; I'll loop her in for bio and availability.

One more operational ask — what are your lead delivery SLA and format (CSV? HubSpot import?). Also need to check COI and payment terms (we generally need net30 unless procurement requires net45).

If you can adjust SOW to include dedicated circuit + one extra monitor and a clause about adjacent competitor restriction, we should be able to proceed.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_DemoPod_Specs.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena@techforum.co>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Breakout track + integration demo pod — initial package

Thanks, Rishi — answers inline: 

1) Power/AV: We can confirm a dedicated 20A circuit to your pod and supply an additional 32" monitor. Please note high-power appliances (e.g., server racks) need advance approval — the dedicated circuit covers a single small appliance plus laptop.

2) Banner mock: attaching a stage banner PDF mock (we will share a higher-res file when we have your logo assets). We can slot Redwood on the top banner rotation for peak visibility.

3) Exclusivity: we will include a limited adjacency restriction forbidding direct platform/inference competitors within 2 booths. We cannot guarantee full category exclusivity on the expo floor but will not place direct competitors within the immediate cluster. Please send your competitor list to finalize.

4) Leads: we deliver opt-in leads as CSV within 7 days post-event and provide a HubSpot import file if you prefer.

Payment terms: standard is 50% deposit on signing, balance due net30 post-event. For a first-time partner we can accept net45 for the balance if procurement requires it.

I attached a redline-ready SOW PDF (SOW_TechForum_Redwood_v1_for_signing.pdf). Fee revised to $43,500 to accommodate the extra monitor and the adjacency restriction.

Next steps: if Marissa is confirmed as speaker and you approve the revised fee, I'll push this into DocuSign.

Best,
Elena
--
Elena Rossi
Director, Strategic Partnerships
TechForum Events
attachments: SOW_TechForum_Redwood_v1_for_signing.pdf
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@techforum.co>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T13:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Breakout track + integration demo pod — initial package

Elena — thanks for the quick updates. Two procurement/ops items from our side: 

- COI: please confirm the minimum insurance requirements and an example COI recipient (we will route to our legal).
- Badge allotment: can you confirm the 10 VIP passes include access to the speaker green room? We also need 2 exhibitor staff badges per day in addition to the 10 VIPs.

Marissa — I'm looping you in to confirm the breakout speaker slot. Marissa, we typically ask for a 5- to 6-sentence speaker bio and headshot; would you prefer 30 or 45 minutes? The program suggests 45 but we can compress to 30 if you want to focus on a demo.

From an ops perspective the revised fee of $43,500 works; request that the DocuSign include the dedicated circuit + one extra monitor explicitly and the adjacency clause with a list of 6 competitors to exclude (we'll send). Also request the DocuSign allow net45 for the final invoice.

If you can send an updated DocuSign by tomorrow EOD we can get procurement moving.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@techforum.co>

We updated the SOW to explicitly include: dedicated 20A circuit, one additional 32" monitor, adjacency restriction (2 booths) and net45 for final payment. COI requirements are listed on page 5 (General Liability $2M, naming Redwood Inference as loss payee is not required — just certificate to our events team).

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/partnerships/TF-4821
Drive sponsor assets folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSponsorDeck

Best,
Elena
